entries.title: Isaiah 54:1
segments: ¶"Sing, O barren, You [who] have not borne! Break forth into singing, and cry aloud, You [who] have not labored with child! For more [are] the children of the desolate Than the children of the married woman," says the LORD.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:2
segments: "Enlarge the place of your tent, And let them stretch out the curtains of your dwellings; Do not spare; Lengthen your cords, And strengthen your stakes.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:3
segments: For you shall expand to the right and to the left, And your descendants will inherit the nations, And make the desolate cities inhabited.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:4
segments: "Do not fear, for you will not be ashamed; Neither be disgraced, for you will not be put to shame; For you will forget the shame of your youth, And will not remember the reproach of your widowhood anymore.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:5
segments: For your Maker [is] your husband, The LORD of hosts [is] His name; And your Redeemer [is] the Holy One of Israel; He is called the God of the whole earth.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:6
segments: ¶For the LORD has called you Like a woman forsaken and grieved in spirit, Like a youthful wife when you were refused," Says your God.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:7
segments: "For a mere moment I have forsaken you, But with great mercies I will gather you.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:8
segments: With a little wrath I hid My face from you for a moment; But with everlasting kindness I will have mercy on you," Says the LORD, your Redeemer.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:9
segments: "For this [is] like the waters of Noah to Me; For as I have sworn That the waters of Noah would no longer cover the earth, So have I sworn That I would not be angry with you, nor rebuke you.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:10
segments: For the mountains shall depart And the hills be removed, But My kindness shall not depart from you, Nor shall My covenant of peace be removed," Says the LORD, who has mercy on you.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:11
segments: ¶"O you afflicted one, Tossed with tempest, [and] not comforted, Behold, I will lay your stones with colorful gems, And lay your foundations with sapphires.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:12
segments: I will make your pinnacles of rubies, Your gates of crystal, And all your walls of precious stones.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:13
segments: All your children [shall be] taught by the LORD, And great [shall be] the peace of your children.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:14
segments: In righteousness you shall be established; You shall be far from oppression, for you shall not fear; And from terror, for it shall not come near you.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:15
segments: Indeed they shall surely assemble, [but] not because of Me. Whoever assembles against you shall fall for your sake.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:16
segments: "Behold, I have created the blacksmith Who blows the coals in the fire, Who brings forth an instrument for his work; And I have created the spoiler to destroy.

entries.title: Isaiah 54:17
segments: No weapon formed against you shall prosper, And every tongue [which] rises against you in judgment You shall condemn. This [is] the heritage of the servants of the LORD, And their righteousness [is] from Me," Says the LORD.
